main_text.p: כְּנִישׁוּת Ch. Collectio, Congregatio, Genes. 1.10. Jon.
כּוּנְשְׁרָא Ch. Umbilicus, Prov. 3.8. Item Verticulū, verticillum, Prov. 31.19. Alii legunt כּוּשְׁרָא.
כנת כִּנְתָּא, כּוּנְתָּא Ch. Spelta, Zea. Plur. כּוּנְתַּיִן, כּוּנְתָּיָא.
* כְּסָא, כְּסָא Vide suprà in כּוֹס.

כסא כְּסִי, כְּסָה Ch. & Syr. Latère, Occultum, Abscondidum esse. Pahel כַּסֵּי Abscondere, occultare, celare, tegere, obtegere, amicire, operire. Ithpah. אִתְכַּסְּיָא & כִּסֵּי Operiri, celari, abscondi, Abscondere se, tegi, obtegi, amiciri.
כְּסִי, כְּסִי Chald. כסא, כסא Syr. Abditum, abscunditum, occultum. Plur. כסיא Occulta, Abscondita.
כּוֹסְיָא Ch. Idem, דְּאִתְבִּיר בְּכוֹסְיָא Quod perditum est clàm, non observante Domino, Exod. 22.8. in Targum Jonath. Duplici mendo ibi est דְּאִתְבִּיר בְּכוֹסְיָא, in Venetis in 8°.
כְּסוּתָא, כְּסוּרְתָא Ch. Vestimentum, Tegumentum, Operimentum, Indumentum, כְּסוּתָא בְּלִיָּא Vestimentum vetus, Jos. 9.5. כְּסוּתָא חֲדַתָא Vestimentum novum, 1.Reg. 11.29.
כְּסוּיִן Chaldaic. Abscondita, Occulta, Secreta, Jobi 11.6.
כסמלא Syr. Operimentum, vestimentum, velamen, pallium.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldaic and Syriac words are transcribed approximately from the scan; vowel points and some letters in the small Syriac and Chaldaic forms are uncertain and may differ from the printed text.
